description.value: Bubble Waffle Cafe is a Hong Kong-style street food chain specialising in egg waffles (雞蛋仔), curry fish balls, rice noodle rolls, fish soup noodle combos, and a broad selection of Asian bubble teas and fruit drinks. The Burnaby outpost sits on the second floor of a Lougheed Highway mall, part of a wider BC chain with locations also in Aberdeen Centre, Public Market, and Park Royal. Cyclists passing through Burnaby can grab a quick hot snack or a customisable noodle bowl before continuing their ride.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM record places this Bubble Waffle Cafe at 4567 Lougheed Highway, Burnaby, level 2 (mall food court). The website confirms an active multi-location chain with online ordering, but its 'Find Us' section only surfaces a Park Royal (West Vancouver) address and phone number — it does not corroborate the Burnaby/Lougheed address, so address and phone cannot be confirmed for this specific location. OSM tags confirm takeaway=yes and the website prominently features online ordering, confirming takeout; no cycling-specific amenities are mentioned anywhere in the website content or OSM tags.
concerns: Address mismatch: OSM lists 4567 Lougheed Highway, Burnaby, but the website's 'Find Us' section shows only a Park Royal location (2002 Park Royal South, West Vancouver, BC V7T 2W4, phone 778-297-0222). The Burnaby location is not shown on the website map, so the OSM address cannot be independently confirmed. The chain has multiple locations and the Lougheed entry may be a separate branch not yet listed on the site.
No phone number is available for the Burnaby/Lougheed location specifically; the 778-297-0222 number on the website corresponds to the Park Royal branch.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active cafe with online ordering and a live website; located in a Burnaby mall and useful to cyclists seeking a hot snack or drink stop.
